show.description: Unloved RADHIKA develops mind-reading after an accident, making her a shield against her treacherous adoptive family (TIYA & VIJETA). A forced marriage ties her to untouchable heir SAHIL DWIVEDI, the only person he can touch. Using her gift, she fights corporate schemes and betrayal to reclaim her father's legacy, becoming a powerful woman who finds unexpected love and resilience in her destined partner. Watch now!
